desc: Parse input: Read H, W, the grid F of building floors, and Q queries.

Derive an efficient algorithm for the problem, focusing on transforming it into a shortest path problem on the grid where edge weights represent the minimum stair cost to move between adjacent blocks, considering the free walkway movement at any floor level. Explore the possibility of precomputing distances or using a modified Dijkstra's algorithm that accounts for the floor levels implicitly.
Implement the derived algorithm to compute the minimum stair cost for each query.
Verify the correctness of the transformation with more test cases, especially edge cases where F[i][j] is much larger or smaller than adjacent blocks.
Optimize the Dijkstra implementation if necessary for large grids.
Ensure the solution handles edge cases like single block or maximum grid size efficiently.
